pages.text: A tea plant should feel like a low evergreen shrub, not a single crop blade. Mature plants have deep, glossy leaves with pale yellow-green buds at the tips.$(br2)The new tea tree textures use dark leaf layers and bright tender shoots so wild tea patches read more like real tea bushes.

pages.title: Fresh Leaves
pages.text: Mature wild tea trees drop 2–4 fresh leaves and may drop a tea sapling; tea seeds come from planted tea crops or crafting. Fresh leaves do not use NBT to decide tea type; the processing steps create the differences.
